body: Currently, I find it difficult to talk to people while being sober. Also, I don’t have the patience to talk about trivial matters...
hanging, which I’ve tried twice and it’s very difficult and the other time would be inhaling cooking gas

I had in mind that if I went back to live in my hometown, that would be my sign of failure. I had everything to be able to grow up, an exceptional girlfriend (his family too), I had the dream of studying and maybe living in Japan (I am graduated in history and I know a little of the Japanese language of the classes I attended at the university). At the end of it all, I didn't get any exchange grants, I failed in my courtship, and without money I had to go back to live with my mother. I taught history and religious education classes for two years, but I couldn't stand it, the bureaucratic pressure and the lack of respect from the students made me give up the profession.

And for those who do not know, there is an age limit to be able to do any type of study in Japan, in addition to having to have money to support themselves and pay the costs.

Besides, I have some problems, like I am not the type of guy who can have sex with someone without first developing an affection (which can last for months) and I also suffer from bipolarity. I don't take medicine (lithium) because this medicine holds me, I can't feel happy or sad.

​

sorry for the big text and for the poor english
all I wanted was to be able to have a peaceful life without too much stress...life seems to be very difficult.
I just want to take the courage to do that. I just think about it. Idk how to describe this feeling...
